recipient_verification.note: Public Hays recruitment post by Ben Godley lists ben.godley@hays.com for Middle East senior hiring and specifically references a Vice President role in metals and mining with relocation welcomed.

messages.subject: Executive Profile | GCC Country Leadership, Mining, ESG & Government Relations
messages.body:
Dear Ben,

I am reaching out for confidential consideration for senior leadership mandates across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the wider GCC. Your Middle East recruitment work across industrial, manufacturing, metals and mining leadership makes this a strong alignment with my background.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at Aurora Gold Mines Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive advisory within a complex mining and major-investment environment. My broader executive experience spans more than two decades across leadership, institutional engagement and operations.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country Director, Regional Director and Head-level mandates across country leadership, ESG and sustainability, government relations, corporate affairs, external affairs, strategic partnerships and stakeholder leadership. I am internationally mobile and open to relocation across the GCC.

My executive CV is attached for confidential review. I would welcome consideration for current or upcoming mandates where my background aligns with your clients' requirements.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | AGM Inc.
Email: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
WhatsApp: +592 624 0964
Website: ragunauthramsaroop.com
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop
